breakdown.description: The global horizontal traction on the left slope is reinterpreted as slope-aligned tangential shear
breakdown.reason: The ground truth specifies applying a global horizontal traction (6000, 0) Pa on the left slope. The generated specification instead applies a slope-aligned tangential shear traction T = 6000 * t (where t is the unit tangent of the left slope), which is exactly the erroneous reinterpretation present in the incomplete prompt. The agent failed to correct this and instead perpetuated the inconsistency.
